caption:
Schengen 90/180 rule: it is a rolling window, not a calendar year.

In any 180 days counting backwards from your entry date, your total days inside Schengen must stay under 90. It never resets on 1 January — it moves with you, daily.

The EU Entry/Exit System now records every crossing digitally. Miscounting is no longer a harmless error; it is a logged overstay that follows your future applications.
